question: Gym members who chose a monthly fee of over $70 instead of $10-a-visit passes paid how much per visit?
answer: About $17. DellaVigna and Malmendier followed thousands of members of three American gyms: those on monthly contracts came about four times a month and would have saved by paying per visit. Many kept paying for months after their last visit. People buy the member they plan to be, then pay for the one they are.
move: Price a plan on your record, not on your intentions.
trap: Assuming people who chose the flat fee must use it enough to gain.

diagram.caption: Over $70 a month, about four visits: roughly $17 a visit against $10.

reference: DellaVigna & Malmendier, Paying Not to Go to the Gym, American Economic Review, 2006
